description: Turn a QRIS payload into a dynamic one for an amount in Rupiah, optionally with a fixed or percentage fee, and recompute the CRC. The merchant account is unchanged. Returns the new payload, ready to render as a QR code.

fee_fixed.description: A fixed fee in Rupiah on top of the amount

fee_percent.description: A percentage fee on top of the amount

name: set_qris_amount
title: Make a dynamic QRIS with an amount
